nom: Peter Thomas Roth Even Clearer Max Complexion Correction Pads

avis.texte: I love using this product to feel extra clean! Sometimes this is fhe only acne product i use in my routine and it works great and doesnt dry out my skin! Leaves me feeling glowy

I've been using these off and on for about 7 yrs now. When my skin starts to get stubborn I buy these and the difference feels almost instant. There is a reason why I keep coming back after all these years. I haven't used the ones with the new packaging, so I'm hoping nothing has changed with the formula! These PTR pads have been so consistent.

I use lots of skincare and for most, I honestly don't really know if it's actually doing anything. This one does. I don't use every night, but on nights I do, my skin genuinely glows the next day. It doesn't help my melasma, but the glow is great!
If you've been struggling with acne look no further these complexion pads really works! Now I need to purchase a product for post acne discoloration!! Thanks PTR

avis.titre: Definitely helps skin! Have been using for years
avis.texte: I don't usually write reviews, but I have been using these for years. I have sensitive skin and these have left my skin clear. I would definitely recommend. If you have any issues with your skin don't hesitate. The smell goes away quickly. I'm usually sensitive to smell, but these so not bother me.

Love adding these to my makeup prep! Works as a great gentle exfoliator, smoothing out sking for seemless makeup application!! I dont use daily so im not sure how harsh these would be if used more regularly though. Great for occasional use!!

avis.titre: Caused my eyes to swell almost shut!
avis.texte: I was so excited when I purchased this product. I love Peter Thomas Roth's products and since having my hysterectomy I was struggling with really bad acne on my chin. I read tons of reviews and decided to pull the trigger with this. I used the product for 4 days 1 time a day and followed up with the Peter Thomas Roth moisturizer. I avoided my eye areas with the Acne Pads every time I applied the product. This morning (day 5) I woke up and my eyes itched bad and were very weepy. I looked in the mirror and my right eye is almost swollen shut and my left eye is slightly swollen. I also had itchy bumps around my nostril that when itched were weepy as well. I am currently on my way to urgent care because of the swelling not going down after 4 hours and some Benadryl instead the swelling is increasing. I even did a patch test and had no issues until day 5!
Dont normally write reviews but this cleared my skin up so fast! If you have sensitive skin or it drys out easily i would not recommend, but if your skin is resilient def get the product

I bought these because I had a medical card from work and had to use the money, little did I know how good they were going to be. After two or three nights, I noticed my face was noticeably more clear and my skin was more even. I don't normally write reviews, but they're very very good.

I started dealing with acne in my late 20's and it has been a battle since. I have tried just about every product geared toward clearing acne, and nothing has worked. I was also blessed with sensitive skin so I was weary of ordering this based off of the strong alcohol comments. Let me just say I noticed a difference the next morning! I have been using this for about 4 months my skin has never been clearer. I do also use this with the acne clearing gel and the water drench foaming cleanser and moisturizer.

avis.titre: Love these but hate the packaging
avis.texte: I would give these 5 stars, but the packaging is terrible. I have two containers of these that are completely dried out. Very disappointing.

I'm 45 yo with combo/oily skin. I struggle with congested pores and agong skinfo. I started using this product for the glycolic acid content. I've kept using the pads for over 1.5 years because they are great! You need to work your way to daily use but I've never had better skin! I use bronzing powder only now because I don't need to "cover" anything.

My son has problem skin and these were magic. His skin has never looked better. I am a product junky ans have tried a lot! I am so glad we found this product. I've repurchased 4 times and will continue to always have these on hand.

I've had bad luck with alcohol bads in the past, so I wasn't sure how these would turn out for me. I absolutely love them. The strong peach/alcohol smell is a little scary, but oh my gosh these are the only things that have worked in clearing up my acne. I am 25 and have suddenly been getting massive breakouts that are under the skin and super painful. Ever since starting to swipe these on my forehead, t zone, and chin every night before bed, I have cleared and kept my acne away. If I were to use them all over my face I would probably become very dry, so I'm strategic with where I use them. Seriously a miracle product for me and I tried everything from Ulta (including the most expensive products offered.) Definitely try these out.
This is just basically a skin toner that smells very powerfully of a peach Jell-O shot. It did nothing for my skin. I was really disappointed after the money I spent.

I love this! Very strong so, if you use a makeup wipe first, you can get the job done by only using half of a wipe. I cut them in half so 1 container lasts me for months. The ONLY negative for me is that it does dry my skin, however, I follow up with a good moisturizer and it works great!

I went out on a limb and purchased this hoping to clear my acne problem on my oily skin. Listen after using this for a month i have to write this review. I'm African American so a lot of products out here aren't so much catered to my skin and it's hard to find something that actually works. I love these pads, when i first started using them i did feel a slight burning feeling but it soon went away after a few seconds. After continuous daily use i didn't feel that sensation anymore because i guess my skin had gotten use to it. I used this twice a day morning/night and i did notice a difference after the first week of use, the acne that i had soon cleared up and went away and i did notice that my skin wasn't excessively oily after using this product. When i did have a pimple form i simply used this pad on it and in about 2-3 days it was dried up and gone so for me it really helped. I know everyone had different skin issues and not every product will be for everyone but at least give this a shot, my skin has cleared up soo much and I've noticed with the additional use of my day/night cream that my skin has evenly toned out. The cons to this is it's really pricy, is it worth the investment yes but if you can find it on sale or use an Ulta coupon to purchase this it'll help out as well.

This product has made me stop breaking out completely, i have hormonal acne so around my period i tend to break out and this has definitely reduced it, to the point where i stopped using my dermatologist products and im totally fine with using this. I dont use this everyday since it is a pretty strong product and its not necessary to do. I will say that this has a very strong alcohol smell that will literally consume your face.

I dont see the hype. My skin has actually WORSENED after using these which is the exact opposite of why I purchased them in the 1st place. Like my entire face is broken out!!! I have new scars and acne like crazy. How does one's skin get worse? Smfh.

avis.titre: Nothing but lots of alcohol and perfume
avis.texte: I advicd everyond to Read the ingredients before buying. Theres like three different types of alcohol in here and 3 different types of perfumes/scents. PTR charges so nuch yet he cant use better ingredients? Passs

Nothing compares to Peter Thomas Roth. Anytime I try something else my skin breaks out and I find myself coming back to PTR to clean up the mess I created. These are perfect for my high breakout areas, my Chin, Cheeks, and Nose. I use them after washing my face and sometimes just when I need a clean up

avis.titre: This gave me my confidence back!
avis.texte: First off, I never go out of my way to write reviews on anything. However, this product is so compelling, it would be criminal NOT to. It hasn't even been a week since I stumbled upon this product and started using it, and it has completely transformed my face. For years I have struggled with cystic acne and have gone through product after product TRYING to help my skin. I've used antibiotics, tretinoin, gels, toners, masks, scrubs, etc., and NOTHING has worked so fast, and so well, than this right here. I cannot wait to see the results after a months use. My skin in this first week alone is visibly/tangibly less inflamed, I'm not coming home from work with more painful acne than what I woke up with, the redness and uneven skin tones are finally beginning to fade, and I don't feel like I'm being weighed down by all the excessive oil my face produces. My husband has made so many comments about how great my skin is starting to look. We were both a little sketched out about the price, as expensive doesn't always mean it actually works. However, after getting the relief I so desperately needed, and the insanely fast results, I will be throwing money at PTR for this product and others I'm excited to try out for the rest of my life. I HIGHLY RECOMMEND this product for anyone in my shoes. We all feel more insecure these days given the standards social media sets out for us, but this product is finally making beautiful skin a reality for me. Please give it a try and do not let the pr

I have used PTR correction pad for about 6 years. The last one i bought is the new design. I noticed that there is so much liquid from the solution soaking the pads. I am wondering if I got a bad batch or if they're all filled with solutions. Like I have to squeeze out the pad.. plus the pad is a bit smaller. It has not worked at all in comparison to the older design/formula. My skin is so much more broke out, as if I aren't even using them at all. I the only one who has noticed this!??? I would recommend the older rounded canister packaging vs the new design.

The alcohol smell is so strong it makes my eyes water and burns my nose when I use it in my T-zone. The product itself seems good, does what it's supposed to and isn't overly harsh or drying on my skin. Not sure if I can get over the smell.

This is intense because it may sting a bit and will promote skin cell turn over. I hate the part that makes me peel but love the after results makes it look so smooth and helps get rid of post hyperpigmentation.
I really enjoy this product! even tho it expensive it is worth it!!
Have only been using for about 2 weeks, can already see a difference in the texture of my skin
This is one of the best parts of my routine, it does dry my face but I follow up with a good moisturizer afterwards. Cleared my face up in less than a week!
I've been using these pads for years. I have very sensitive skin so I only use them once or twice a week. Great glyco-peel alternative.

I wouldn't use it 2x a day as recommended. I was using it daily at night and it worked when I had any acne and it would get rid of them within a couple of days and usually keep them at bay. My esthetician said to use it 3x per week max because it can be drying and cause more acne.
I buy this all the time for my 13 yo. When we run out acne worsens. We use 2 times a day. Doesn't dry out skin. Really helps with oiliness.
The first day I used this I saw results! This is better than an Rx that I got from a dermatologist and I have been to many over the years.

Best thing ever! I tried these once before in a free promotional box and they cleared up my face instantly. I constanly get complements of how clear and healthy my face looks. Highly reccommed. Absolutley worth the money!

I have been having issues with bad acne for the last year. I have tried many products but my acne was being so stubborn. I tried these pads and they have worked so well!!! They have really helped clear me up! I still get small pimples but have not had any of the big painful ones since I started using this product! The smell is a little strong when applying but totally with the results and the smell is gone once it dries on you after a few seconds.

I was using the pads regularly and enjoyed them. However, while traveling, they were tossed around in my bag and at some point, were no longer right side up. This caused all of the liquid from the pads to be absorbed into the paper piece that fits inside the cap (see photo attached). So now, all of the moisture from the pads is actually in that top piece and the pads are no longer usable (see photo attached). I wasn't even halfway through my supply when this happened. Wanted to let others know so they don't experience the same thing! When I emailed customer service about the issue, they didn't seem to care!

avis.titre: Smoothes out skin texture and clears blackheads!!!
avis.texte: I truly believe this product helped get rid of my stubborn blackheads, especially on the sides of my nose. I used this as part of the 5piece acne clearing kit and it is part of my daily night care routine. The alcohol content and smell is pretty strong so use sparingly. I cut the pads into smaller pieces.
Love this product! Unfortunately, I have adult acne and experience occasional breakouts. This worked great, not only in clearing up the acne quickly, but preventing future breakouts.
This is an excellent product and it does work. I'm kind of blown away how it has helped eliminate forehead acne. The moisturizers in the formula help keep skin feeling nourished as it's improving.
Definitely a staple in my cleansing routine! Cleared up my adult acne
Please please make your products sulfate and paraben free so I can make your products my go to!
Bought this when they were on sale to try and now I'm hooked. I got all my friends hooked on these pads. After big events or long days I use these after cleansing.

As a person with adult acne, I am always on the search for the best items that help my acne without drying out my skin. These pads are a game changer. I have been using them now for years and I cannot ever be without them! These have helped clear my skin so much and also are great for anti aging as well.
This product is great, it can be harsh but just use it twice a week. Great exfoliate for oily skin with dark spots. My skin is smoother and much brighter, love the smell.

Since I've started using these pads, just once in the morning, my face has been a dream. Old blemishes cleared up. I haven't had anything new that's lasted longer than 24 hours. My skin is smoother and the tone is evening out. Overall, I'm thoroughly pleased with how nicely these pads are effecting my skin. They dry down with a slight Peach Bellini scent that is pleasant and not bothersome. Give these a go! I think you'll also be pleasantly surprised 🙃
36 years old with adult acne. This has REALLY REALLY a helped the texture of my skin. I did buy it during the 21 days of beauty but will definitely rebuy at regular price!

I wish I never used this product. I consider my skin normal & had very minimal breakouts on my jaw line. With simply one use whatever skin the medicated pad touch became extremely irritated. I went to sleep & woke up in the middle of the night to my face severely burnt & with hundreds of tiny pimples on my entire face, including areas I've never broken out at. A week later I'm now left with a severe burn mark throughout my entire face & skin beyond textured. And top of that my skin is extremely dry, no amount of moisturizer has been able to help. Just save yourself all the trouble.

I love these cleansing wipes more than I expected. They leave my face so soft and smooth and they have significantly decreased the amount of facial acne I was getting and my complexion looks better overall. They also smell really good.

I do believe in good exfoliating for glowing skin. I use this pad after cleansing my heavy make up with the make up remover/ facial cleansing towelettes. Making sure the gunk of make up and the dead skin lifted up. After that I put on toner (a must) and serum or night cream at night.

I've only been using these for about a week but already I've noticed a dramatic difference in my skin. I struggle with acne off and on and they're the deep blemishes that stick around for weeks. When this came in I had one developing just above my jaw line. Used this product at night and the following day it had a white head and was ready to pop. That never happens! Usually they get very inflamed, swollen, and painful. I'm almost never able to get them to have a head which means they take forever to resolve. I typically get tired of waiting and mess with them, leaving an even bigger mark. 😭 Now, a few days after using these pads at night, it's gone and there's very little mark to even know it was there. Y'all! I'm shook. Really! I've also started using the Tula toner, which also has glycolic acid in it and so it could be that these two are a power combo. Regardless, I don't think I'll ever be without either one again. Oh yeah- I should also say that the rest of my face feels smoother and my complexion looks more even. I got this at the 21 days of beauty sale and am completely satisfied.

I am a big fan of all PTR acne products. This is the only brand that has kept my acne in check. I have been using these correction pads for 5yrs and when I do get break out it's really mild healing time is short and helps with fading my dark spots fast. Yes please try thank me later.
They are a little harsh at first but I use them every other day now. My skin seems less dull, and I can tell the texture of my skin seems to be brighter and smoother.
I use 2x/day after washing my face. Love that it's great for getting off any residue as well as an astringent for pores and toning & evening the skin
I have been using this product for about 2 weeks. I definitely notice a huge improvement. The acne on my forehead and chin have definitely decreased and have not dried out my skin
These pads are magic for clearing up skin. Ive been dealing with red bumps and after a week of use- they are clear now. Yes, the smell is really strong, but its not terrible.

The scent is the only reason I find something wrong with this product. It's not overloading, it could just be the medicated portion that makes the smell strong. I will say that I use this for the black heads on my nose that just won't seem to go away before and within a couple of days I have seen a huge difference. I haven't had this product for long tho so I can't speak on the dryness just yet, but I can see how it will if you don't follow up with a good moisturizer. Would rate 4.5 if I could. Will see if it lives up to the fine line part.

I literally got these yesterday during 21 days of beauty and used half of one pad (as suggested by another user) last night and it already made a difference this morning! I've had a few stubborn acne spots that just would not heal and after using this one time, this morning they are already significantly smoother and less visible. I wish I had bought more than one! Will purchase again!
This is a very good exfoliating pad this smoothes out the skin very nicely HOWEVER it has a very strong scent which hurts the eyes and nose a bit but it goes away very fast.

These are a game changer. Oh the glow you have after just one use! I have extremely sensitive skin and eczema, these are just wonderful especially for pores and acne. (my pores aren't very big to begin with.)

I don't have sensitive skin, but I did have acne. I bought these pads regularly and had been using them for close to a year. On days when I forget to use them, I started to develop these big red patches - I could pick them off but it would only make it worse. At that point, only I use the pads is when the patches go away. It's like my skin had a dependency to it. Anyway, I think it has to do with such potent ingredients/acids that it dried my skin out to the point of being irritated. It took a long time to figure out that it was this product in my routine that was the culprit, and when I completely stopped using it, I had a long purge period that included redness and patches. I still have that redness today, and I bought these at least 5 yrs ago. I would be wary of using this; it's very strong stuff and can damage your skin.
Best face pads I've ever used. Clears all types of breakouts and exfoliates just enough. Just moisturize face and wash hands after you use or it will dry hands out.

The smell is terrible. It literally makes my eyes water. I feel like these work okay but works just the same as a good acne toner which is half the price. Feels like it really drys my face out as well.

I'd been searching for an "over the counter" more reasonable priced correction product for larger pores, uneven skin tones and for something that worked for over 50. This is it for me. This is my 3rd jar and I absolutely love it, I use it once a day at night. My makeup even goes on better. I know all products do not work for everyone but I highly recommend giving this a try.

Dooo nottt use !!!!! I used this for a long time and then realized its loaded with parabens (scientists have show tumor growth especially in breast cancer with paraben use) so i threw it in the trash. For being so expensive you would think PTR would invest in some better ingredients for its customers.
Working well so far as with any skin care routine I'm pretty sure it's a journey not a sprint!

I have struggled with adult acne for the past 3 years. This has single handedly made the biggest difference in the look and feel of my skin. It is so much smoother, softer, with much fewer breakouts. I highly recommend this.

I had been trying out different face washes and skin care products for a while trying to find something to help smooth out my complexion. I read reviews on this product and decided to try it out. I can honestly say after using this product for a couple weeks, I started to see a difference and decreased areas of redness. I ended up buying this again because I was so pleased with the results. My skin is typically not very sensitive or prone to break outs, so I did not have any problems with that. I typically use this every other mornings after a facial cleanse and love how my skin feels and looks after use!

I had so many break outs on my forehead and it made me so insecure but then i bought this product and a month later i have not one pimple on my forehead! I feel so much better about myself thanks to this product.

avis.titre: Compared to Stridex? I'll take the Stridex
avis.texte: I'm 33 and have had cystic acne off and on for 20+ years. I used to strip my skin with toners and pads like these. I sprung for these during a sale because I was having a bad acne week anyway. The scent is there but it's overpowered by chemicals anyway. These strip my skin the same way the Stridex pads do (I only use them when my acne is bad) but at twice the cost. I tried them .

My face started to get really bad Acne due to wearing the masks for more than a year, I have used so many stuff and nothing works, until someone told me about this product after using it for 3 days my face came back to what it used to look like before wearing masks. Love it
Max Complexion cleared my problem areas quickly, without over drying my skin. I will be added it to my skincare routine.

It clears your skin, improves complexion, and you immediately notice a difference after the first use. This is my third jar and I hope they never discontinue this product. My favorite so far. I got my sister to start using this product and it cleared the acne from her chin. Amazing product, worth the price.
This has helped my hormonal acne especially on my chin. I have dry skin and this product did not dry my face. The scent is good. Also great for blackheads on my nose!

This has really helped me with my hormonal acne. I cut the pads in half and use one half in the morning and the other half at night. I don't find it's too drying on my face but I also pair it with a good moisturizer. I've had no new acne pop up since using this product.

Since I got these I have noticed my hormonal acne has disappeared and also my skin feels so clean and glowing. It may be a but drying but paired with a good moisturizer it's heaven. I cannot be without these now.
My skin feels so smooth. I have a glow and healthy looking skin. I've noticed my acne has slowly cleared and my pores have minimized.
I been struggling with acne for years and I finally found someone that works perfect for me. I am so happy to have this product in my life. Highly recommended

I noticed a couple of pimples on my upper arm, so I used this in the morning. It did get rid of the pimples, but unfortunately it dried out my skin so bad it started bleeding, and that was after only a few days of using. If you're not prone to acne I suggest not using everyday. It works but can be very drying.
Starting to see improvements in just one week. It works!!! thanks
My skin looks great ! I only use 1/2 a pad two times a week. I follow with a moisturizer or face oil & WOW!

This product works well, but I agree with other reviewers, it does cause a sting. My moisturizer helps take the bite away. I typically use this every other day because it does dry out your face. I also cut the pads in half. The pad cut in half is more than enough to get the job done. I haven't had any hormonal breakouts since starting to use this product.

I have been using this product for about one week now and I have already noticed a difference in my pore size! I love the scent and how the product feels on my skin. The scent is quite strong and may be a turnoff to some that are sensitive to smells, but I don't mind it.
I'm using this product for my back since I'm prone to getting acne there. So far I've been using them every night and no pimple has popped up. It's a great product and it's easy to apply .

avis.titre: I'd forgotten how much I like PTR products
avis.texte: It amazes me that these little pads still find a trace of dirt still left after cleansing and toning. Helping pore appearance.

I'm undecided about this product. I've been using it only 1 week. I purchased because I've had some uncharacteristic breakouts lately. Pro: the breakout areas have gotten better although I've also incorporated la roche posay effaclar cleanser which is amazing, so I'm not sure If my skin has settled because of that product. Con: the first ingredient is alcohol! The smell is basically unbearable. I have to hold my breath while applying then literally step away from the mirror and breathe. Plus I know alcohol is not great for the skin. If you can get past that it's OK but is it worth it?
As a 50+ year old woman, I still battle acne breakouts. This product seemed to make a difference after just ONE use. It's effective and it doesn't have a medicinal odor.

avis.titre: Smells like nail polish remover and dries face
avis.texte: I dont like this product as it dries out your face and burns. It smells like strong nail polish remover.

avis.titre: This product works for adult acne!
avis.texte: I decided to try this product because it was half price during the 21 days of beauty and I love it! I use it at night after I wash my face, before bed. There is a definite noticeable difference in the amount of acne on my face. This product is not too drying either. It is pricey, but so are facials. I recommend sticking up when there are specials.
Should have stocked up on this product. My skin feels good ,looks better. Pricey, will watch for more sales, but if you can afford it, give it a try, can't say enough!
Amazing product my skin has some rough and dry spot now are gone. My skin looks radiant and dewy even after I put on makeup .
I only used it once and it literally burned my skin. My nose was peeling and it looked awful. It's been a week and still is in the healing process.
Made me breakout every time I used it also smells like straight peach vodka. Does not feel or smell nice because of the strong alcohol scent. Not worth it

I'm giving this product 2 stars and to be fair, I've only just started using this and I haven't seen real results. I will continue to use this product and give it time to see maybe if things will change and en ese entonces, I'll write another review (if my opinion changes) I did get this during 21 days of beauty and I was super excited because I always hear positive things about Peter Thomas Roth's products. However, this is a very HARSH product and by that I mean, it doesn't tingle my face or makes my face irritated.. It feels almost as if it is too much for my face to handle. Upon applying, I squint my eyes because it's just too much.. That's the only way I can explain it. The smell is strong. After getting over the first few seconds. I did get over the harshness however, each time I apply I still feel like it's a strong product. I'm trying to work my way into this product.. sooo, let's see. As of right now, I would not repurchase.

These complexion pads are pricey, but worth it. I have combination, sensitive skin that was more congested than I realized. They will help you get rid of blackheads, whiteheads, and congestion under skin with regular use, just don't start out using too often. Once a day or every other day. They can be very drying and caused my skin to peel, initially. Best to use this at night after wash face and apply a heavier night cream right after. Using serums before the night cream is an even better idea with this before bedtime. After just a few days use, my skin is feeling smooth and glowing. I enjoy the peach belini scent, but be prepared that these are strong with all the ingredients, so can be a little overpowering when first use. You get used to it. TIP: Each pad has a lot of product on it, if you want it to go further and last longer, then cut each pad in half.

I was skeptical buying this item after reading reviews, but I'm so glad I did! After three days of using I started to see a difference. My skin was brighter and the blackheads around my nose started to clear up. Don't let other views sway you from trying something.......everyone has different results!
my skin felt a burning/tingling sensation but no difference or change to my skin. pretty disappointed with the product. this is not good for people who have sensitive skin

Don't get this if your skin is sensitive. I tried this for 6 months to see if my soon would improve but i see no difference. it's nice for exfoliating but it's not something I'd buy again. pretty disappointed

This has been a staple in my life for years. It's the right strength for results and not going overboard and drying it out or making it worse. I have fair/sensitive skin and I can't go without these little magic pads. I actually get nervous when I start to run low. My teenager kids are hooked on them too! As a side note these little babies kill any bikini rash in the summer as well! One swipe and it's gone in a few hours. I recommend these to anyone that asks and I was in the beauty industry as a nurse injector for years prior to the pandemic. I'd get skin questions regularly.

avis.titre: Best product we have used that works!!!
avis.texte: My son uses this product on his face for his acne. Thank you to Rachel from the Plymouth meeting store who suggested this product.

Love these pads. They really dried up my acne. I used them twice a day, I did get pretty dry but they dried up my acne. Now I only use them in the morning after washing my face. Love them. I cut them in half so they last longer

These pads are pricey but boy are they worth it. I use these day and nights (follow with good moisturizer) and my skin has cleared up so much. My acne prone skin left me with blackheads and consists t zits and whiteheads. I had two stubborn blackheads for at least 6 months and it helped to purge that. These are intense so I would recommend only using once a day or every other day until your skin becomes accustomed.

I've been using this product for YEARS! I cut the pads in half to make them last longer. I'm in my 40's and constantly pass for early 30's. It brightens my skin and makes me look fresh and less oily. I use it at night and follow with a rich moisturizer. I can't live without it! Lol

I am on my 3rd container of these! I work in a medical office and due to COVID have a mask on while in the office. This has been helping with the dreaded maskne! I love this and would highly recommend. I already got a few of the others in my office on this too!

avis.titre: So good if use right and consistently
avis.texte: This makes your pores look smaller, your skin look smoother and glowy. Over time it makes marks and blemishes go away. I wish I used tris when I was a teen. It does dry you out so you have to build up to how often you use it, or maybe doesn't matter since Its the mask era it doesn't matter.

avis.titre: Excellent for my SUPER oily skin!
avis.texte: I decided to try these out after I started developing hormonal acne from stopping my birth control. I have the oiliest skin of anyone I know AND I live in Florida so my face is basically a swamp. I honestly didn't have much hope, but I was pleasantly surprised! These REALLY made my face feel squeaky clean after washing and I haven't had any irritation or dryness.
